# SpriteSheetLayout

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record SpriteSheetLayout
```

How a sheet is laid out: a grid of cells, in the Set's own canvas size.

## Remarks

**The cell is the CANVAS, never a size the caller picks.** Every asset in a Set is the canvas size by construction — the CookBook fixes it and `Validator` checks every variant against it — so a cell that disagreed would mean either scaling the art or cropping it, and this project resamples nothing anywhere. A sheet is a stitch, not a render.
